scope.purpose: Compare the reviewed bounded OPC read_limited growth candidate through the existing DOCX owned-ingress workload, with owned_vec retained as an unchanged route control.
scope.candidate_production_scope: Only crates/litchi-opc/src/phys_pkg.rs changes production read_limited capacity growth. The candidate source also carries the focused reader_ingress.rs test and the existing ZIP64 fixture required by the frozen quality closure.
scope.overall_adoption: pending DOCX gates, required XLSX 0779 boundary controls, independent review, and root decision

hypothesis.candidate: When a read exceeds Vec capacity, request bounded_input_capacity(current_capacity, new_len, maximum) instead of exact new_len capacity.
hypothesis.expected_effect: Reduce repeated exact-read reallocation requests on large owned-reader ingress while preserving the 8 KiB read request, maximum-plus-one probe, short/Interrupted-read behavior, fallible reserve, and typed error order.
hypothesis.interpretation_limit: The DOCX corpus is an in-memory workload. It does not establish cold storage, network, physical copy traffic, or general OPC performance.

source_constants.expected_reserve_policy: reserve only when new_len > data.capacity(); additional = target_capacity - data.len(); try_reserve_exact(additional)
source_constants.validation: Runner checks these constants and expression against frozen candidate source bytes; no strong expectation is inferred from a workload report.

report_validator.role: Independent DOCX report shape, timing conservation, allocation conservation, process status, correctness, sink, and ingress validation.

child_validation.role: Hash-bound ChildSpec boundary; terminal receipt is durably written before report parsing and semantic validation; no retry.

synthetic_fixture_provider.role: Synthetic report construction only; never used as the formal semantic validator.

normal.pairing: same block and route; operation p50 is computed from each child’s 50 validated operation samples

allocator.pairing: same repetition and route; allocator reports retain 50 warmups-discarded samples, and open-phase gauges are compared per paired child

schedule.calibration: none; the existing synthetic controls exercise schema/counter checks without adding real workload children
schedule.order_is_frozen_by: schedule rows and SHA-256 emitted by comparison-runner.py --check-schedule and bound into the authorized manifest

binary_binding.identity_rule: Normal timing compares only normal probes-off binaries. Allocator elapsed values are never substituted into normal timing; allocator binaries are bound independently by lane, source root, feature, receipt, and SHA-256.

correctness_and_custody: All 60 children reach terminal status, exit 0, close their process groups, and pass the independent report validator.

Every workload report binds the historical source_revision, frozen corpus source/output hashes, route, warmup/sample counts, correctness gates, source immutability, inverse, sink bounds, and owned-reader ingress counters.

Source listings, receipts, build terminals, binaries, runner, helper, validator, plan, and max RSS sidecars remain hash-bound. Any failed or missing child invalidates interpretation; retain it and do not retry.

normal_safety_required_for_both_adoption.criterion: For every paired normal block and route, candidate operation p50 / baseline operation p50 <= 1.05.
normal_safety_required_for_both_adoption.tail_review_flags: Retain and review any paired candidate/baseline p95, p99, operation spread, or max RSS ratio > 1.05. Spread is (max - min) / min within each child’s operation samples. No route pooling hides a flagged pair.
normal_safety_required_for_both_adoption.rss: Compare external /usr/bin/time maximum RSS directly from raw KiB sidecars; report process snapshots separately and do not treat diagnostic-off process as present.

latency_adoption.ratio: baseline operation p50 / candidate operation p50
latency_adoption.criterion: Median of the 12 paired reader ratios >= 1.05 and the nearest-rank bootstrap 95% lower bound is strictly > 1.0.
latency_adoption.bootstrap_statistic: For each draw, sample 12 paired ratios with replacement and take their midpoint median; sort 10,000 draw medians and use ranks 250 and 9,750 for the two-sided 95% interval.
latency_adoption.scope: Descriptive DOCX latency adoption candidate only; it remains subject to all correctness, source, binary, normal-safety, tail/RSS review, XLSX controls, independent review, and root decision.

allocation_adoption.requested_bytes: Per child, median allocated_bytes across the 50 validated allocator samples; candidate must be at least 10% below baseline in all 3 paired reader repetitions.
allocation_adoption.calls: Per child, median allocation_calls; candidate strictly lower than baseline in all 3 paired reader repetitions.
allocation_adoption.reallocations: Per child, median reallocation_calls; candidate strictly lower than baseline in all 3 paired reader repetitions.
allocation_adoption.memory_safety: Across both routes and all 3 pairs, retain live_bytes_after, peak_live_bytes_after, region_peak_live_bytes, and external max RSS as separate absolute metrics. Any candidate/baseline ratio >1.05 is a retained memory flag; allocation adoption requires all such route/pair flags resolved as safe by review.
allocation_adoption.scope: Requested allocator bytes and call counts are allocation evidence; they do not measure physical copies or imply RSS savings.

gates.overall_rule: A DOCX adoption path may be considered only if its primary gate passes, every normal safety pair passes, all memory/correctness/custody requirements pass, no unresolved review flags remain, the XLSX 0779 control matrix is complete, and independent review plus root authorization accepts the result.

failure_policy.observation_timeout: Poll the same process; only a confirmed 900-second deadline terminates it and invalidates interpretation.
failure_policy.sidecar_order: Do not parse max-rss-kib.txt until perf_child_validation has written and the runner has observed the child terminal receipt. Preserve raw sidecar bytes and parse result.
failure_policy.invalid_child: Retain terminal, stdout, stderr, report, validation, and RSS sidecar; mark the cohort invalid rather than replacing the child.

storage.raw_packet: External only; no report, log, source listing, binary, or executable is written under docs/performance/results.
storage.repository_outputs: Only small plan/runner/reducer/control scripts and compact receipts may be added under docs/performance/results/change-0941; apply the repository size checks before any commit.
storage.source_listing_regeneration: Use the retained source-candidate-v3 listing receipt; do not regenerate from the mutable checkout during capture.
